newsitem.title: USA: Foundation Health in talks with Physicians Health.
newsitem.headline: Foundation Health in talks with Physicians Health.

text.p: Foundation Health Systems said it was engaged in discussions with Physicians Health Services regarding its possible acquisition of Physicians Health.
Foundation Health said terms of the proposed transaction were being negotiated but both companies thought a final price would be about and not above $30 per share.
A number of outstanding issues still needed to be resolved, the company said.
Foundation Health said there could be no assurances discussions would result in a takeover and there would be no more announcements until a pact was reached or talks were terminated.
Physicians Health is the parent of three health maintenance organisations in Connecticut, New York and New Jersey. Foundation provides managed healthcare services.
